messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Turkish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Turkish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Tant' | adverb “so” (intensifier) | Öyle | “so” | OK | | è (1) | copular verb “is” | — *(implicit in “fazladır”)* | “is” | UNNECESSARY | | amara | adjective “bitter” | acı | “bitter” | OK | | che | conjunction “that” | ki | “that” | OK | | poco | adverb “little” | biraz | “a little” | OK | | è (2) | copular verb “is” | — *(implicit in “fazladır”)* | “is” | UNNECESSARY | | più | comparative adverb “more” | daha | “more” | OK | | morte | noun “death” | ölüm | “death” | OK | | ma | coordinating conjunction “but” | Ama | “but” | OK | | per | preposition “in order to” | için | “for” (purpose) | OK | | trattar | infinitive “to treat / discuss” | ele almak | “to take up / discuss” | OK | | del | preposition + article “of the” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | ben | noun “good” | iyiyi | “the good” (accusative) | OK | | ch'i' (1) | relative pronoun + pronoun “that I” | — *(expressed in “bulduğum”)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | vi | adverb “there” | orada | “there” | OK | | trovai | verb “found” (1st sg past) | bulduğum | “that I found” | OK | | dirò | future verb “I will tell” | anlatacağım | “I will tell” | OK | | de | preposition “of” | — | — | UNNECESSARY | | l'altre | adjective + article “the other” | diğer | “other” (article omitted) | OK | | cose | noun “things” | şeyleri | “things” (accusative) | OK | | ch'i' (2) | relative pronoun + pronoun “that I” | — *(expressed in “gördüğüm”)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | v'ho | clitic + auxiliary “there have” | — *(location expressed by “Orada”)* | — | UNNECESSARY | | scorte | past participle “seen” | gördüğüm | “that I have seen” | OK |
---
### Items flagged
**UNNECESSARY** (elements that have no separate lexical counterpart in Turkish):
- è (both occurrences) – copula expressed by the suffix “‑dır” in “fazladır”. - del – Turkish does not use a separate “of the”. - ch'i' (both occurrences) – incorporated into participial adjectives “bulduğum”, “gördüğüm”. - v'ho – location already covered by “Orada”. - de – preposition “of” omitted; case marking suffices.
No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Turkish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Turkish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 7: - Original: Öyle acı ki ölüm biraz daha fazladır; - Issue: none - Corrected: Öyle acı ki ölüm biraz daha fazladır; - Line 8: - Original: Ama orada bulduğum iyiyi ele almak için, - Issue: none - Corrected: Ama orada bulduğum iyiyi ele almak için, - Line 9: - Original: Orada gördüğüm diğer şeyleri anlatacağım. - Issue: none - Corrected: Orada gördüğüm diğer şeyleri anlatacağım.
